description.zh: 指定修改后授权规则的备注信息，最多支持500字符。
description.en: The new remarks of the authorization rule. It can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh: 修改后授权的数据库实例和数据库账户列表。
description.en: The databases and database accounts that a user associated with the modified rule can manage.

description.zh: 修改后授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）。
description.en: The end time of the new validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 修改后授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）。
description.en: The start time of the new validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 修改后授权的资产组和账户列表。
description.en: The asset groups and asset accounts that a user associated with the modified rule can manage.

description.zh: 修改后授权规则关联的主机ID与主机账户ID数组。
description.en: An array that consists of the host IDs and host account IDs with which the modified authorization rule is associated.

description.zh:
要修改的授权规则所在堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose authorization rule you want to modify.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
要修改授权规则所在的堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the authorization rule to modify belongs.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
The ID of the authorization rule to modify.

description.zh: 修改后的授权规则名称。长度为1~128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的半角句号（）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角单引号（'）以及空格。
description.en: The new name of the authorization rule. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), single quotation marks ('), and spaces. It cannot start with a special character.

description.zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户组ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the user groups with which the modified authorization rule is associated.

description.zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the users with whom the modified authorization rule is associated.

title.zh: 修改授权规则基本信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zmb2y9ydw08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 68 --rule-name test --comment TEST --effective-start-time 1669630029 --effective-end-time 1672502400 --user-ids 1 --user-group-ids 1 --hosts '[{"HostId":"1","HostAccountIds":["1"]}]' --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"2","DatabaseAccountIds":["2"]}]' --host-groups '[{"HostGroupId":"1","HostAccountNames":["root"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyRule --region cn-hangzhou --Comment TEST --UserIds.1 1 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-zmb2y9ydw08' --Databases.1.DatabaseId 2 --RuleId 68 --Hosts.1.HostAccountIds.1 1 --Hosts.1.HostId 1 --Databases.1.DatabaseAccountIds.1 2 --EffectiveEndTime 1672502400 --EffectiveStartTime 1669630029 --UserGroupIds.1 1 --HostGroups.1.HostGroupId 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostGroups.1.HostAccountNames.1 root --RuleName test --method POST --force
